t: Espressif's ESP32-S3 audio board for voice, speaker, and intercom projects.
steps: Buy the ESP32-S3-Korvo-2 from DigiKey and add a 4 ohm 3 W speaker.
Get a 5 volt 2 amp USB power supply for the power port.
Install Visual Studio Code and the Espressif ESP-IDF extension.
Download ESP-ADF from Espressif's GitHub page.
Connect the second USB port to your computer for flashing and logs.
Build and flash the first music playback example from the ESP-ADF getting started guide.
Try the ESP-SR wake word example next.
meta: Open Board. From $49.95. A few stores.
